title: Inter College Technical fest URJA 2k22
content:
Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering is organising Inter College Technical fest URJA 2k22 in association with IETE, for Diploma Electronics students on 3rd August 2022 at ATME College of Engineering.

As a part of the fest following activities will be conducted.

*Prezento (Poster Presentation)
*Hackathon(6Hrs project building competition)
*Technical Quiz
*Project Expo(Exhibition of projects)

For queries contact
